newsitem.title: USA: Plains cattle seen priced $72-$73 next week -trade.
newsitem.headline: Plains cattle seen priced $72-$73 next week -trade.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle markets likely will be priced from $72.00 to $73.00 per cwt next week, versus $71.00 sales this week, cattle feeders said.
Many feedlot managers said they have been marketing cattle earlier than expected to take advantage of profitable prices.

"I'm almost 40 days ahead on marketings," said one Kansas feedlot manager. He said profitable prices and attractive prices for replacement feeder cattle encouraged him and other feedlots to be aggressive sellers of slaughter cattle.
"The deferred (CME futures) offer no hope," he said. "Replacements now have a very good potential to make money."
Other feedlot sources reported similar situations. This week's cattle have been sold, showlists should be equal in size or smaller than this week's and cattle should be priced from $72 to $73.
However, meat packers may not be aggressive buyers early in the week. Some feedlot sources said packers appear to have enough cattle for slaughter needs through early next week.
